meta_description:
13K likes, 478 comments - daveramsey on July 25, 2026: "Do you make good money, but still wonder where it all went? You’re overdrafting, the debt keeps piling up, and you’re sick and tired of being sick and tired.
 
It’s time to take control.
 
Give every dollar a name before the month begins with @everydollar, start working the 7 Baby Steps, and attack your debt with the debt snowball.
 
You CAN do this. One year from now, your life can look completely different. Are you ready to make a change?".
